description: What a host is, as its hello says (and sessions carries).

models.description: Every model it can run: {value, displayName}, a Codex model's as its catalogue has it.

checkout.description: Where its code is (a head here run from elsewhere is told so).

init.description: What a session's program last said to initialize, with every model it can run in it.

commit.description: The git commit its code was as it started (null: not a checkout).

made.description: When that commit was made, in seconds (null: not a checkout).

behind.description: How many commits it lacks of the mesh's newest code (mesh's newest), as its git counts them (null: it can't).

heads.description: The apps on its machine connected to it, by the code they run (each counted behind as its own commit is).

update.description: Its own updater's newer version, if it has one ready.

restart.description: Its restart, kept till nothing blocks it (restart), or null: none pending.

mesh.description: The members it reaches and the links it's made.

notes.description: Record's notebooks here, as written last (notes.stamp: "" for none).

edits.description: The edits proposed to the pages of Record's notebooks here, as written last (notes.edits_stamp: "" for none).

ops.description: The ops it takes, given by a host that takes only part of the wire (a phone's), with what its sessions take besides (start's ephemeral; control requests: control, set_permission_mode, set_model).

telemetry.description: Its telemetry state: the apps on its machine tell it telemetry only while it's on, and profile what it says.

tool_names.description: How its MCP tools are named: what every head shows for one ("Mesh / Tasks").
